hypothesis: Between alpha 0.75 and 1.00 three axes move TOWARD the candidate while resolution flips away from it: adverse 26->28, challenge 23->24, resolution 13->12. If those transitions happen at DIFFERENT alpha there is a band with adverse 28, challenge 24, multihop 8 and resolution 13 — 163/168 with zero regressions, which is promotable. If they flip together there is no band and every arm carries a regression.
why_this_band: The alpha curve is NON-MONOTONIC, so intermediate points are not predictable from the four already measured. multihop reads 8 at alpha 0, 0.5, 0.75 and 1.0 and dips to 7 ONLY at 0.25, so this band avoids the one observed multihop artefact. alpha=1.00 already scores 162/168 and its ONLY regression against the incumbent is resolution -1.
honest_expected_value: Roughly even odds at best. No training is performed, so this cannot damage anything; it either finds a promotable blend or proves the band is empty. Cost ~2.5h of one L40S, about $2.50.
